name: Tokyo
notes: Primary Golden Route anchor; also common arrival/departure point.

name: Kyoto
notes: No airport; reached by shinkansen. Has its own accommodation tax schedule (see taxes.json).

name: Osaka
notes: Common Kansai gateway; frequently used as a cheaper base for Kyoto day trips.

name: Hakone
notes: Onsen town, common 1-2 night side trip from Tokyo.

name: Nara
notes: Usually a day trip from Kyoto or Osaka rather than an overnight base.

name: Hiroshima
notes: Reached via Sanyo Shinkansen; gateway to Miyajima.

name: Kanazawa
notes: Reached via Hokuriku Shinkansen from Tokyo.

name: Takayama
notes: Reached via limited express from Nagoya; no shinkansen access.

name: Kawaguchiko
notes: Fuji Five Lakes; base town for the Yoshida Trail. Reached from Tokyo by highway bus. Season-gated: the climb itself is only realistic July 1 - Sept 10/11 (see seasons.json).

name: Onomichi
notes: Shin-Onomichi shinkansen stop on the Sanyo line; the Honshu-side start of the Shimanami Kaido cycling route. Old port town with a well-known temple-walk trail.

name: Imabari
notes: The Shikoku-side end of the Shimanami Kaido cycling route from Onomichi.

name: Iya Valley (Miyoshi)
notes: Remote mountain valley in Tokushima, historically a Heike-clan refuge; known for vine bridges (kazurabashi). No shinkansen or major rail; reached by bus/limited express via Ikeda. Sparse public transit once there -- most visitors rely on lodging shuttles, taxis, or a rental car.
